documentation.accessibilityText:
CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Expose structured locale-aware segments, grids, or channels rather than display-string identity.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Enter, Escape

FOCUS

Segment Focus, Grid Focus Repair, Restore Focus

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2, 4.1.3

These requirements come from the canonical Color Picker catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.
documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ColorPickerRoot,
  ColorPickerLabel,
  ColorPickerControl,
  ColorPickerTrigger,
  ColorPickerPositioner,
  ColorPickerContent,
  ColorPickerArea,
  ColorPickerAreaThumb,
  ColorPickerChannelSlider,
  ColorPickerChannelInput,
  ColorPickerSwatch,
  ColorPickerHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/color-picker'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ColorPickerRoot name="brand-color" defaultValue="#635bff" alpha messages={{"channels":{"r":"Red","g":"Green","b":"Blue","alpha":"Alpha"}}}>
      <ColorPickerLabel>Brand color</ColorPickerLabel>
      <ColorPickerControl>
        <ColorPickerTrigger type="button">Choose color</ColorPickerTrigger>
        <ColorPickerSwatch />
      </ColorPickerControl>
      <ColorPickerPositioner>
        <ColorPickerContent>
          <ColorPickerArea>
            <ColorPickerAreaThumb />
          </ColorPickerArea>
          <ColorPickerChannelSlider value="r" />
          <ColorPickerChannelInput value="r" />
        </ColorPickerContent>
      </ColorPickerPositioner>
      <ColorPickerHiddenInput />
    </ColorPickerRoot>
  )
}
